ragLab.title: RAG end to end — interactive visualizations
ragLab.intro: Four Canvas scenes to actually see the RAG pipeline: how documents become vectors, how similarity search finds the right chunks, how HNSW skips through layers, and how chunking decides everything before embedding even happens.

flow.title: Full RAG flow — ingestion (offline) + query (online)
flow.subtitle: Top (magenta) is the offline pipeline that prepares Qdrant. Bottom (cyan) is the online pipeline that runs on every question. Qdrant in the middle is shared.

cosine.title: Vector space (simplified 2D)
cosine.subtitle: Real embeddings have 384+ dimensions — the principle is the same. cos(θ) = (A · B) / (|A| · |B|)

hnsw.title: HNSW — hierarchical layered search
hnsw.subtitle: Top layer is sparse (long jumps). Base is dense (contains all). Greedy descent — walks down to the nearest neighbor of the query.

chunking.title: Chunking — how the document becomes pieces for the vector DB
chunking.subtitle: Move the slider and switch the strategy. Red borders mark cuts that destroy semantics (mid-word or isolated heading).
